no_adcom_quote.quote: An advisory committee meeting was not convened during the first review cycle. Additionally, no advisory committee meeting was convened during the current review cycle.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for ELELYSO (taliglucerase alfa) during any review cycle of BLA 022458. The review documents explain that the product shares similarity with previously approved enzyme replacement therapies for Type 1 Gaucher disease (Ceredase, Cerezyme, Velaglucerase) and that no new or unique concerns were identified, so no AdComm was needed. Because no committee met, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
